issues.summary: A csh setup path emits a vendor -env_path request when LocalFlow sources it.
issues.entry: public TaskCreate with shell=/bin/tcsh and source=[relative .csh path]
issues.expected: The selected task shell sources the ordered path list as an interactive csh setup without LocalFlow inventing vendor arguments or a vendor environment-file path.
issues.actual: The reported setup emits 'Environment variables file does not exist ... -env_path'. A bounded tcsh container probe showed tcsh -ic evaluates the command body with prompt unset (prompt=0), the usual condition used by setup files to take their noninteractive error branch.
issues.reproduction_proves: The selected shell's missing prompt is a concrete, path-list-compatible trigger for the supplied diagnostic class.
issues.reproduction_does_not_prove: It does not identify the user's proprietary setup file or establish that every vendor uses prompt for this branch.

attempts.hypothesis: tcsh -ic loses the interactive prompt contract before LocalFlow sources paths.
attempts.method: Run /bin/tcsh -ic and read $?prompt inside the LocalFlow target image.
attempts.analysis: A csh file guarded by !$?prompt naturally follows the vendor error branch without any missing source path.
attempts.why_not_reproduced: The exact vendor source file and its server environment were not supplied.
attempts.evidence: 2026-09-17 local Docker console capture before Docker Desktop became unavailable.
attempts.next_condition: Run the public TaskService regression in the Ubuntu target image and, if it persists, capture the resolved source path plus the vendor file's guard condition.

attempts.hypothesis: The public Linux target regression can be run locally.
attempts.method: Build/run the systemd source-list target container.
attempts.observed: Docker Desktop Linux engine pipe npipe:////./pipe/dockerDesktopLinuxEngine was unavailable; starting the manual service was denied by host permissions.
attempts.analysis: The target environment did not start, so this is an environment block rather than a product pass/fail.
attempts.why_not_reproduced: No usable local Linux container daemon remained after bounded retries.
attempts.evidence: docker build/docker version failure output on 2026-09-17.
attempts.next_condition: Restore Docker Desktop Linux Engine access or consume the GitHub Ubuntu target receipt.

issues.fix_candidate: Before every csh/tcsh source line, set prompt only when it is absent; preserve ordered source paths, fail-fast behavior and the frozen working directory. No -env_path is generated.

issues.summary: The user reports that a left-button hold and drag cannot select terminal text.
issues.entry: terminal page, live and retained xterm output
issues.expected: A normal pointer hold, multi-position drag and release creates xterm's native selection; right-click Copy and Ctrl+C copy exactly that selection.
issues.actual: The user reports no text selection. The current local Edge public journey performs a 380 ms hold, eight-step drag and release in both live and retained output, then verifies exact clipboard text through the native selection path.
issues.reproduction_proves: The current built application accepts the complete native pointer sequence in the local Edge environment.
issues.reproduction_does_not_prove: It does not identify the user's deployed artifact, browser/device or any host overlay that may intercept the gesture.

attempts.hypothesis: A synthetic/short drag previously hid a held-pointer regression.
attempts.method: Use Playwright mouse.down, wait 380 ms, mouse.move with eight steps, wait, mouse.up; consume selection by Ctrl+C and context-menu Copy in live and history views.
attempts.observed: The current local production browser journey passes and copies qa-terminal-ready exactly.
attempts.analysis: The gate now measures the user gesture rather than a programmatic selection surrogate.
attempts.why_not_reproduced: The reported server/browser artifact was not available to automate.
attempts.next_condition: Verify the exact published artifact, then capture browser/version and overlay diagnostics if a deployed instance still blocks selection.

issues.fix_candidate: No speculative runtime interception change: strengthen the real-gesture gate and publish the verified build; investigate only from a reproducible deployed artifact if the behavior remains.

learning.source: tcsh interactive prompt behavior and the installed LocalFlow shell-boundary contract
learning.terminal: xterm native selection plus the installed operator-interaction catalog
learning.machine_gate: feedback records cannot advance past reproduction_blocked merely because a local substitute passes; target-environment evidence is required for release claims.
